subject: Forum Goes Live!
author: ZombieTron
body:
The results are in!

BurnoutAholics users have narrowly voted in favor of a forum.  The forum is now active for you to use. If you have any other comments or suggestions please let us know.

As the vote was so close the forums will be under review for a while, if they are not successful we may remove this feature at a later date.

Thanks for voting. This is Your Burnout FanSite and Your opinions really do make a difference! 😃
